articles.title: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
articles.description: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

articles.title: Trump asks Congress for billions for Iran war, after tension with Republicans
articles.description: But the budget faces an uphill battle as the president spars with some members of his own party over the issue.

articles.title: Oil price falls back to pre-Iran war levels
articles.description: Signs that traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route is gradually resuming has helped to push the oil price down.

articles.title: Biggest city in Crimea without power after Ukraine strikes
articles.description: Sevastopol's Moscow-installed governor warns there will be no electricity in some areas until the evening.

articles.title: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
articles.description: Rafael Grossi says the IAEA is "working on modalities" but an Iranian  minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

articles.title: Trump says 'courageous' Zelenskyy 'doing pretty well' in war with Russia
articles.description: Donald Trump praised “courageous” Volodymyr Zelenskyy as he said the Ukrainian president was “doing pretty well” in the war against Russia.
